title: Feltham Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency medical, urgent care, and local readiness help points in Feltham.
content: For immediate life-threatening emergencies, call 999 or 112 right away. 1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals: West Middlesex University Hospital (Twickenham Road, Isleworth TW7 6AF) — 24-hour A&E. Travel from Feltham station: ~4 miles north-east; take bus 235 or 117 towards Isleworth/Hounslow (~25-30 mins). St Peter's Hospital (Guildford Road, Chertsey KT16 0PZ) — 24-hour A&E located ~7 miles south-west via the A308/M3 corridor. Nearest Major Trauma Centre is St George's Hospital (Blackshaw Road, Tooting SW17 0QT). 2. NHS Urgent Treatment Centres: Ashford Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre (London Road, Ashford TW15 3AA) — open daily 8am to 8pm for minor wounds, sprains, and ailments (note: no full A&E). Travel from Feltham station: ~2 miles west; take bus 117 or 203 towards Ashford (~15 mins). West Middlesex Urgent Treatment Centre (Twickenham Road TW7 6AF) — open 24 hours. 3. Local Hazard Notes: The Longford River, Duke of Northumberland's River, and River Crane flow through Feltham and Hanworth; low-lying banks and culverts can experience localized surface flooding during sustained downpours. 4. Supplies: Feltham High Street (The Centre shopping area) and Uxbridge Road in Hanworth feature major supermarkets and pharmacies providing first-aid materials, hygiene items, and potable water. Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
